objective: Train L3s (scale-free memory, curriculum 200-800), L3m (step-counted memory, mixed to 3200), L3sm (scale-free, mixed to 3200) and L1sm (what-only scale-free memory, random where, mixed to 3200) by OpenAI-ES, two seeds each; test with the WHERE-NEXT baselines and win rule at rand 3200, 12800, 51200 and local 3200.
status: Scale-free memory carries the navigating agent to parity with re-tuned Novelty+ at rand 3200 and 12800 (frozen R 0.94 and 0.82 [0.73, 0.91], inconclusive by the rule; post hoc five runs 0.88-1.01), where step-counted memory collapses (1.36, 14.5); S = L3s/L3 = 0.059 at 12800, L3sm/L3s = 0.95 (training at 3200 adds nothing once reads are scale-free); no CPU win; every arm loses on local 3200; 51200 stress cell pending. Computed, referee pending.
title: Scale-free memory and mixed-size training for the navigating agent
